verdict.rationale: The recall docs say that when no search type is specified, recall() classifies the query and picks a retrieval strategy automatically. That implies developers can choose among multiple search types instead of one fixed similarity search. A founder also says nodesets work like tags and enable graph filtering, which loosely suggests metadata-style scoping, but this is community-sourced and not documented in detail. Missing for 10: documented metadata filter parameters, explicit keyword/BM25 or hybrid search modes, any reranking support, a documented list of selectable search types, and hands-on corroboration.
